title: Personalised learning path
subtitle: A study plan built by AI from your goal, weekly time budget and current skills

form.heading: Build your own path
form.intro: Tell us what you want to achieve. The system reads the published course catalogue, retrieves relevant materials and orders them into steps.
form.goalPlaceholder: For example: Become a web developer
form.goalHint: The more specific the goal, the closer the path will fit.
form.hoursHint: Between 1 and 80 hours. Used to split the total hours into weeks.
form.hoursInvalid: Hours per week must be a whole number between 1 and 80.
form.skillsPlaceholder: Type a skill and press Enter
form.skillsHint: Press Enter or type a comma to add one. Leave empty if you are starting out.
form.skillsEmpty: No skills added — you will be treated as a complete beginner.

generating.heading: Building your path
generating.note: Five agents run one after another and call a language model, so this usually takes tens of seconds. Please keep this page open.
generating.stagesNote: The server only responds once all five agents finish, so this is the running order, not live progress.

agents.gap_analyzer: Compare the goal to find missing skills
agents.resource_retriever: Retrieve learning materials for each step
agents.validator: Check ordering, hours and that every course is real

error.loadBody: The server returned no data. Try reloading; if it keeps failing the AI service is down.
error.generateTitle: The path could not be generated
error.unavailable: The AI service is not responding or has run out of model quota. Nothing was generated — please try again in a few minutes.
error.rateLimited: You have generated paths too many times in a short period. Wait a moment and try again.
error.timeout: The server did not answer in time. The path may still be generating — reload in a few minutes to check.
error.noFakeData: We do not show a placeholder or sample path.
error.openBody: The server did not return the contents of this path.

path.viewingOld: You are viewing an older path.
path.noSteps: This path has no steps. Please generate it again.
path.noSkills: No skills recorded for this step.
path.noCourse: This step is not linked to any course in the system.
path.noResources: No materials were retrieved for this step.

history.heading: Previous paths
history.empty: No paths in your history yet.

empty.heading: You do not have a path yet
empty.body: Fill in your goal below and the system will build your first one.
